verdict.rationale: Pigment's documented MCP offering is an MCP server that lets external assistants like Claude, Cursor and ChatGPT reach into Pigment. That is the server role, not the ability to plug MCP servers into Pigment. Agent Connectors let Pigment's agents reach systems like Notion, Google Drive and Slack, but they are never described as MCP-client support or as a way to add arbitrary MCP servers, so they are an adjacent feature that earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
